command_conditions.common_initial_seed: +0.4 E_r and F_l for first 50 neural calls at 2 ms (=100 ms); initialization, not a stride clock
command_conditions.POST_BAL_FUNC: clamped off; rg_tonic_current=0; old DRIVE disabled by Runtime.prepare_inputs

metadata.display_frame: x anterior, y superior, z right
metadata.sample_phase: After accepted outer physics interval; warmup excluded. Neural input/start and force interval times retained separately.
metadata.regional_sensor_definition: Physical ground contact locations projected from calcaneus toward toes; virtual regions, not calibrated heel/toe pads.
metadata.force_definition: Once-counted force on each foot, transformed from contact frame into anatomical world axes. Regional trace is true superior component, not normal-force proxy.
metadata.harness_definition: Pelvis generalized passive-force wrench projected on solver-stage root-joint axes unless caller supplies apparatus wrench; confirm only apparatus spring/damper acts on those coordinates. Explicit support kept separate.
metadata.kinematic_evaluation_phase: Contact frames/body xpos are from the latest solver evaluation; qpos/qvel are final state. No extra forward call is made to retime those intermediate quantities.

configuration.diagnostic_scope: Frozen four-command Hunt fit, matched live afferent encoder, no direct posture/MN command; air curriculum probe

metadata.stimulus_policy: NaN means not logged; never synthesize an inferred pulse.
metadata.body_weight_definition: Pelvis subtree mass times9.81; excludes separate fixed ground/apparatus bodies.

legacy_assessment.frontal_scope: Pelvis-frame calcaneus/tibia origins; not foot-edge clearance or full self-collision.

measured.harness_wrench_frame: Native world x anterior, y left, z superior. Anatomical right force = -world y. Torque is pelvis joint-restraint generalized torque projected on instantaneous axes; not a physical single attachment load cell.

adopted.scope: Suspended-air validation only; legacy assessment retained; no ground stepping or body-balance claim

1.cycle_window: 5 <= t_state < 14 s; knee sign inverted only for flexion-peak detection, raw coordinates retained
